question: Which of the following options is associated with the class of cold-blooded animals?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chameleon**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chameleon is associated with the class of cold-blooded animals**. 
 
• Cold-blooded animals, **also known as ectotherms or poikilotherms, **are animals that cannot regulate their body temperature internally.
 
• Instead, **their body temperature changes with the temperature of their environment.**
 
• Examples of **cold-blooded animals include **
 
• **Frogs**
